code: const BASE_URL='https://mailclean-api-production.up.railway.app';export async function verifySingle(email){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE_URL,"/verify/single"),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email})});if(!res.ok)throw new Error('Verification failed');return res.json();}export async function verifyBulk(file){const formData=new FormData();formData.append('file',file);const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE_URL,"/verify/bulk"),{method:'POST',body:formData});if(!res.ok){const err=await res.json();throw new Error(err.detail||'Upload failed');}return res.json();}export async function pollJob(jobId){const res=await fetch("".concat(BASE_URL,"/results/").concat(jobId));if(!res.ok)throw new Error('Failed to fetch job status');return res.json();}export function exportUrl(jobId){let category=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:'all';return"".concat(BASE_URL,"/results/").concat(jobId,"/export?category=").concat(category);}
